items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: People told them about Puss and they told them about Paul Barbarine, they told them about different fellas.

ctx.x: Well how do these men in the grass band get jobs anyway, huh? Well they get them all kinds of ways.

They get them through being members of organizations. They get them through friends that know them better than they know others. See if they, it's like if you have a friend, regardless of what he is, if you got something that you can do in his way, you give it to him. Now regardless of who he hired, it don't make no difference. You're looking to him. Yeah. You're looking to the void. See, now all you want boys to do is bring you a band. You understand? And that's the way it is with them boys. See now I had a…
What about the churches, do they ever get any jobs through churches? Who is that? You, I mean with your band. Do the churches ever hire brass bands? Well no, they never hire them.

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I mean like the guy I play with John Kazma, he's pretty good. What's his name again? Tillman, Wilbert Tillman.

ctx.x: They have a couple of tuba players around here. I mean like the guy I play with John Kazma, he's pretty good. What's his name again? Tillman, Wilbert Tillman.
